_comment: Seat inventory for the four sponsor seats. ONE seat is sold once and renders on BOTH dsh.works and dshthemes.com, so this file is the single home for it — dshthemes fetches it from here at build time (scripts/sponsors.mjs) and caches it. Hand-edited; there is no CMS and there does not need to be. A seat is sold for one year and the dates are printed on the site, so an expired seat is visible rather than quietly renewed. `checkout` is the Stripe Payment Link for one seat-year; while it is null every seat links to `terms` instead of a checkout that does not exist. `terms` MUST be absolute — dshthemes.com renders the same value and has no /sponsor page. NOTHING in this file may reference a plugin slug, a theme, a tag, or any registry field: a seat buys the box, and the box is not part of the dataset.
